rules.statement: A court may address an issue of fidei commissum even if not specifically raised as an issue, provided it is indirectly brought up during the trial and the judge deals with it in the judgment.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The issue of fidei commissum has been dealt with by the trial Judge even though this question was not raised as an issue. It appears that the question of fidei commissum has been indirectly brought up in points of contest No. 9-12 and the specific point was raised in the course of the trial. Per Wimalachandra, J.
